# Built-in themes

Set one with `theme: <id>` in `config.yaml`. Writing your own is covered in the [themes guide](../themes.md).

| id | Name | Appearance | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sp-night` | SP Night | dark | The city at 3 a.m.: tokyodark's blue-violet dark, with the sodium streetlight burning warm on top. |
| `sp-night-garoa` | SP Night Garoa | dark | The same window seen through the drizzle. Flat grey: the garoa does not cool the city, it fades it. |
| `sp-night-jaragua` | SP Night Jaraguá | dark | The same night from the city's highest point: the dark turned toward the green of dense forest, with the red-and-white tower lit at the top. |
| `dracula` | Dracula | dark | The vampire dark theme: purple, pink and neon green over blue-grey. |
| `everforest-dark` | Everforest Dark | dark | A comfortable green forest: moss background, soft tones that are easy on the eyes. |
| `gruvbox-dark` | Gruvbox Dark | dark | Retro and warm: earthy browns, orange and burnt yellow, medium contrast. |
| `kanagawa` | Kanagawa Wave | dark | Hokusai's Great Wave: sumi ink, wave blue and the Fuji white of the paper. |
| `nord` | Nord | dark | Arctic and clean: Polar Night, Snow Storm, Frost and Aurora. |
| `onedark` | One Dark | dark | The Atom classic: graphite grey with balanced blue, purple, green and orange. |
| `rose-pine` | Rosé Pine | dark | All natural pine, faux fur and a bit of soho vibes: soft tones over an almost black purple. |
| `rose-pine-dawn` | Rosé Pine Dawn | light | Rosé Pine at dawn: the light variant, cream paper and purple ink. |
| `rose-pine-moon` | Rosé Pine Moon | dark | Rosé Pine under the moonlight: the same mood on a slightly lighter background. |
| `tokyonight` | Tokyo Night | dark | Downtown Tokyo lights at night: dark blue background, neon blue and magenta. |
| `tokyonight-storm` | Tokyo Night Storm | dark | Tokyo Night under a stormy sky: the same neon over a lighter slate blue. |
